reason: I'd rather wire an LLM API into my own site than pay 29 EUR a month for a widget. A cute mascot doesn't solve a problem I can't solve myself in a weekend.
objection: Another monthly subscription for something visitors might ignore. I have no proof a mascot lifts conversions, and on-site actions are locked behind the 79 EUR Pro plan.
would_change_my_mind: Hard data from comparable small sites that the mascot raises conversions, plus on-site actions on the Starter plan at around 15 EUR.
